serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Hi.
Hobo: …
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: Who are you?! You are not getting your stuff back, ok?! Window was already broken anyway!
You: N-no, it’s me. The guy you attacked before.
#Hobo.Face.normal
Hobo: Oh! Right.
Hobo: You are pretty far from home. What do you want?
You: My friend is being beaten up by some thugs, I could use some help. I don’t know how much he can take it…
Hobo: That sounds pretty bad, but I don’t understand what you want from me! I got a bunch of stuff I just stole here that I need to protect. If I go now, all these vultures nearby are gonna take it for themselves!
You: Come on man! There’s too many of them. There’s nothing I can do on my own.
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: Fuck off! Thanks to these riots I scored big time! I have so much food and warm clothes that I can live like a KING for weeks!
You: Remember who helped you when you were being attacked? I ask you to return the favour!
Hobo: God, you are annoying! 
Hobo: Do you really want me to leave all this stuff behind? It’s worth at least a few hundred dollars!
You: Alright, I can pay you back! Let’s just go!
Hobo: I hope your friend is worth it! I’m not cheap!
